extDescription.message: Journal articles to clean Markdown with math, tables and references: PMC, PubMed, Springer, Nature, Frontiers, MDPI, PLOS, eLife.

actionTitle.message: Journal to Markdown — export this article

btnExportTitle.message: Download this article as a .md file

btnCopyTitle.message: Copy the full-text Markdown to the clipboard

routeUsedJats.message: Source: Europe PMC JATS (structured full text).

noticeAbstractOnly.message: Abstract only: no open full text was found.

noticeJats_timeout.message: Europe PMC did not respond in time.

noticeJats_not_available.message: Europe PMC has no open-access full text for this article.

noticeJats_parse.message: Europe PMC returned XML that could not be read.

noticeJats_invalid_id.message: The PMCID on this page looks invalid.

noticeJats_mismatch.message: The Europe PMC full text belongs to a different article.

noticePubmedFulltext.message: Full text found through Europe PMC ({pmcid}).

noticeEquationImage.message: Some equations only exist as images and were kept as image links.

err_unsupported_page.message: This page is not supported. Open an article on PMC, Europe PMC, PubMed, Springer/BMC, Nature, Frontiers, MDPI, PLOS or eLife.

err_site_planned.message: {site} is not supported yet; it is planned for a later version.

err_not_article.message: Open a single article page, not a search or list page.

err_no_content.message: No article content was found on this page. If it is a sign-in or preview page, check your access and reload.

err_content_unreachable.message: Cannot read this tab. Reload the page and try again.

err_download_failed.message: The download failed. Check the browser download settings and try again.

err_clipboard_failed.message: Could not write to the clipboard. Click the page and try again.

err_unknown.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

optWelcomeBody.message: Open an article on PMC, Europe PMC, PubMed, Springer/BMC, Nature, Frontiers, MDPI, PLOS or eLife, then click the Markdown button at the bottom right of the page, click the toolbar icon, press Alt+Shift+J, or right-click the page.

optIncludeImagesHelp.message: When off, figures keep their captions only.

optPreferJatsHelp.message: Fetch structured full text (JATS XML) first: from Europe PMC for open-access articles (on publisher pages it is looked up by DOI), or from the publisher's own XML on Frontiers. If that fails or times out, the page itself is used.

optSitesHelp.message: Turn a site off to stop exporting from it.

optPrivacy.message: Articles are converted inside your browser. Only when you export or copy an article does the extension ask Europe PMC (EMBL-EBI) for its open-access full text, sending only the PMCID or DOI — no cookies or page address. Opening the popup sends nothing. PDF parsing is off by default; when you turn it on, see the PDF parsing section above for what is sent.

err_page_changed.message: The page is still switching to another article. Wait until it finishes loading, then try again.

routeUsedSiteXml.message: Source: the publisher's XML (structured full text).

noticeJats_not_found.message: Europe PMC has no full text for this DOI.

btnZipTitle.message: Download article.md and its images in one ZIP file

noticeZipAll.message: All {total} images are in the ZIP; links point to images/.

noticeZipPartial.message: {packed} of {total} images are in the ZIP. The other {failed} are on {hosts}, which does not let extensions download them; they keep their web links in article.md.

fabHidden.message: The button is hidden. Turn it back on in Settings › Output.

optShowFab.message: Show the Markdown button on article pages

optShowFabHelp.message: A small M↓ button at the bottom right of supported article pages: download .md or ZIP, or copy.

pdfButtonTitle.message: Send this article's PDF link to {provider} and download the result as a ZIP

pdfConfirmText.message: This article is not open access. Uploading it to {provider} may violate the publisher's terms. Continue?

pdfStateRunning.message: {provider} is parsing the PDF ({progress}%). You can close this popup; the result downloads when ready.

pdfErr_AUTH_INVALID.message: {provider} rejected the token. Check it in Settings › PDF parsing.

pdfErr_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.message: The {provider} quota is used up. Try again later or choose another service in Settings.

pdfErr_RATE_LIMITED.message: {provider} is busy. Try again in a minute.

pdfErr_FILE_UNSUPPORTED.message: {provider} could not read this PDF (it may need a login or block automated downloads).

pdfErr_TOO_LARGE.message: The PDF is too large for {provider}.

pdfErr_NETWORK.message: Could not reach {provider}. Check your connection and try again.

pdfErr_PERMISSION_MISSING.message: Permission for {host} is missing. Turn PDF parsing on again in Settings to grant it.

pdfErr_TIMEOUT.message: {provider} did not finish in time. Try again later.

pdfErr_CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Not sent: this article is not open access and was not confirmed.

pdfErr_PDF_DISABLED.message: PDF parsing is turned off in Settings.

pdfErr_BUSY.message: Another PDF is still being parsed. Wait for it to finish.

pdfErr_reason_key_not_on_device.message: No {provider} token on this device. Add it in Settings › PDF parsing.

pdfErr_reason_forbidden_empty.message: {provider} refused the request (empty 403). Restart the browser and try again.

pdfErr_reason_dnr_not_ready.message: The network rule for {provider} is not active yet. Close all extension pages and try again in a moment, or restart the browser.

pdfErr_reason_interrupted_submit.message: The browser stopped the previous PDF task. It was not resent; start it again if needed.

pdfErr_reason_empty_result.message: {provider} returned no text for this PDF. Nothing was saved.

optPdfHelp.message: When a page has no usable full text, the article PDF can be parsed by a third-party service with your own token. Off by default. Only PDFs licensed CC BY or CC0 (or on a fully open-access site that states no stricter licence) are sent without asking; for CC BY-NC / ND / SA and any other article the popup asks you every time.

optPdfEnabledHelp.message: Turning it on asks the browser for access to the selected service only.

optPdfNote_paddleocr.message: PaddleOCR (Baidu AI Studio) receives the PDF link and your token, downloads the PDF itself, and returns text and images from *.bj.bcebos.com. Free daily quota.

optPdfNote_mineru.message: MinerU (OpenDataLab) receives the PDF link and your token, downloads the PDF itself, and returns a ZIP from cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn.

optPdfTokenHelp.message: Stored only in this browser (not synced). Sent only to the selected service.

optPdfDenied.message: The browser permission was not granted, so PDF parsing stays off.

noticeZipNone.message: No images could be packed: {hosts} does not let extensions download them. The ZIP has article.md only, with web links to all {total} images.

noticeZipNeedsPermission.message: {count} image(s) are stored on {hosts}, which needs your permission. They keep their web links in article.md. To include them, click Download ZIP in the toolbar popup and choose Allow.
